src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_cd118_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 118th Congress's districts (its file says session 118).
rec: 2021 Congressional plan drawn by the court's special master and adopted by the Connecticut Supreme Court on Feb. 10, 2022 (In re Petition of Reapportionment Commission, SC 20661), effective Feb. 15, 2022; 5 districts
Connecticut General Assembly, 2021 Redistricting Project: Congressional Maps ('Adopted by the State Supreme Court 2/10/2022')
A light-touch plan: 4 of 5 district areas differ from the 2020 file by more than 0.5 percent but by at most 3.5 percent (a few towns moved). Census cb_2022 cd118 file agrees with the 2024 file.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: 2021 State Senate plan, certified by the Reapportionment Commission on Nov. 23, 2021; 36 districts
Reapportionment Commission vote tally, 11/23/21: 'Certification of the State Senate Plan of Districting'

First used in the Nov. 2022 election. Census cb_2022 sldu file: LSY 2022; 25 of 36 areas differ from the 2020 file by more than 0.5 percent (up to 25 percent) and the file agrees with 2024 (max difference 0.2 percent).

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: 2021 State House plan, certified by the Reapportionment Commission on Nov. 18, 2021; 151 districts
Reapportionment Commission vote tally, 11/18/21: 'Certification of the House of Representatives Plan of Districting'

First used in the Nov. 2022 election. Census cb_2022 sldl file: LSY 2022; 128 of 151 areas differ from the 2020 file by more than 0.5 percent (up to 61 percent); agrees with the 2024 file (max 0.4 percent).
